title: San Jose woman's disc that was bigger inside than outside

So Jacques Vallee describes a woman in San Jose seeing this, you know, flying saucer. She walks in, she's in a movie theater all of a sudden.

as_told.title: Vallee's San Jose case: craft bigger inside than outside

plain: A woman in San Jose, California, is said to have seen a big disc over her house, and once inside it found it far larger than it looked, like walking into a movie theater, where a being led her up a staircase. The computer scientist and longtime UFO researcher Jacques Vallée tells it from his case files, and Michels retells it citing him, adding the movie theater detail, while Vallée in a later episode adds the being and the staircase.
